shots.caption: Five-star rain chase: AIR-1 spotlight, spike strip and roadblock on the Neon Mile escape, NOS gauge burning blue.
The Tide Runner 900 idles outside the Neon Mile casinos at night, wanted level four, rain on the neon.
Flat out on Runway 27 at sunset, NOS level three, the Midnight Run clock ticking down.
Silent Pier: Deke slips between sentry vision cones, detection meter climbing toward the alarm.
